families.label: Price
families.note: A tradeable bar at the date. Every other column is gated on this one.

params.rule: Close ≤ the rebalance date, with a bar in the last 14 days (28 pre-2002) — the engine's entry-freshness gate.
1-month price change % (needs a close 30 days earlier).

families.label: 52W band
families.note: Trailing-365d high/low, from true intraday H/L where the bhavcopy carries them.

params.rule: Distance below the 52w high %.
Distance above the 52w low %.
52w range position — null when high == low.
Days since the 52w high.

families.label: Momentum
families.note: Trailing returns — each needs a close that far back.

params.rule: Return over 30 days.
Return over 91 days.
Return over 182 days.
Return over 365 days.
This month's return minus last month's (needs 60 days).
3m return ÷ volatility (needs both).
6m return minus Nifty's 6m return — needs nifty.json to reach back that far.

families.label: Trend
families.note: Moving averages and the industry ranking built from them.

params.rule: Distance from the 50-day SMA %.
Distance from the 200-day SMA %.
Industry momentum rank 1-10 — assigned to every screened row, so this tracks Price.

families.label: Risk
families.note: Volatility, beta and drawdown over 90-180 day windows.

params.rule: Annualised volatility — needs >2 returns in the trailing 90 days.
Beta vs Nifty over 120 days — needs >5 paired stock/Nifty returns, so it is 0 before nifty.json starts.
Max drawdown over 182 days.
Share of up-days over 90 days.

families.label: Oscillators
families.note: Need enough consecutive daily bars — the pre-2002 weekly era cannot supply them.

params.rule: Wilder RSI(14) — needs 15 bars before the date.
MACD histogram — needs >35 closes in the trailing 320 days.
Stochastic %K(14) — needs closes in the trailing 21 days.
Bollinger %b — needs >1 close in the trailing 28 days.

families.label: Liquidity
families.note: Turnover and share-volume, from the bhavcopy.

params.rule: 20-day average daily turnover. turnAvgAt() returns 0 — never null — when nothing is recorded, so a plain non-null test would read 100% forever; this column counts > 0 only.
5d ÷ 90d turnover — null when the 90d average is 0.
5d ÷ 90d share volume — null when the series carries no volume array at all.
20-day average delivery % — null when no bar in the window carries a delivery figure.

families.label: PAT (point-in-time)
families.note: Quarterly net profit, visible only from its filing date — no look-ahead.

params.rule: Net-profit YoY % for the latest quarter FILED on or before the date, vs the same quarter a year earlier. Null when the year-ago base is exactly 0.
The year-ago quarter's net profit itself.
This quarter's YoY minus last quarter's YoY.
Consecutive +YoY quarters — 0 is a real answer, so every row with a filed quarter counts.

families.label: PAT TTM
families.note: Needs 8 consecutive quarters, so it lags the plain YoY by ~2 years.

params.rule: Last 4 filed quarters vs the 4 before them — needs all 8 present.

families.label: Post-result drift
families.note: Price move since the last earnings date.

params.rule: Return from the close on the last filing date to the date — needs both a filed quarter and a close on that filing day.

families.label: Revenue & margins
families.note: From sf_revop, made point-in-time with sf_fundamentals' filing date for the same quarter.

params.rule: Revenue (consolidated, else standalone) for the latest quarter filed on or before the date.
Operating profit (consolidated, else standalone) for that same quarter.
EBIT for that same quarter — the sparsest slot in the file.

families.label: FII
families.note: Quarterly shareholding filings, visible from their submission date.

params.rule: FII holding % from the latest SHP filing submitted on or before the date.
QoQ change in pp — needs the calendar-previous quarter too, and is deliberately never computed across the Sep-2022 SEBI reclassification.
DII holding % from that same filing.
QoQ change in pp — same previous-quarter and Sep-2022 rules as FII.

families.label: Industry
families.note: Classification is a CURRENT attribute, not point-in-time — it answers "is this stock classified today", asked of that date's members.

params.rule: The dataset's industry for the symbol is known (not "Unknown"/"Other").

families.label: QM composite
families.note: Derived ranking — needs TTM growth, 12m return and volatility together.

params.rule: Cross-sectional z(profitTTM) + z(ret12m) − z(vol); null when any input is missing.

noHistory.why: Always 0 in survivorship-free mode — the NSE bhavcopy carries no market cap. Use Turnover for size.
Same: always 0. Never filter or sort on it.
shareholding.json holds only the last 8 quarters; the engine-facing shp_engine.json carries FII/DII only, so there is no long history to count.
